## Normal region analyses
Here, we focus on cells belonging to the intermediate population (Cluster 3) located within the histologically normal fallopian tube, which may represent cells undergoing early transformation and therefore provides an opportunity to study the earliest stages of high-grade serous ovarian cancer development.

First, required libraries are loaded
```{r load libraries, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(Seurat) 
library(dplyr) 
library(ggplot2) 
library(patchwork) 
library(dbscan)
library(FNN)
```

## Data import
The Xenium object generated from the SpatialCopyInference workflow is imported. The object contains cell annotations, spatial coordinates, inferred copy number profiles and BANKSY clusters for the ovarian Xenium dataset.

```{r Import data paths}
xenium.obj <- readRDS("Data/Xenium_ovarian.rds")
```

Next, cells belonging to the histologically normal fallopian tube region are subset for downstream analyses.

```{r Subset}
# Subset normal region
box <- list(xmin = 7800, xmax = 10100, ymin = 3750, ymax = 6050)

coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(xenium.obj, image = "fov")
cells_keep <- colnames(xenium.obj)[
  coords$x > box$xmin & 
  coords$x < box$xmax &
  coords$y > box$ymin & 
  coords$y < box$ymax]

xenium.sub <- subset(xenium.obj, cells = cells_keep)

coords_sub <- GetTissueCoordinates(xenium.sub, image = "fov")

# Remove full Xenium object to reduce memory usage
rm(xenium.obj)
gc()
```

## Cell type composition
Here, we investigate the spatial distribution of cells with in Cluster 3 and compare cell type composition between Cluster 3 and non-cluster 3 within the normal fallopian tube region.
```{r Cell type composition, out.width = "100%", fig.height = 2.5}
# Define Cluster 3 cells
plot_df_sub <- data.frame(cell = colnames(xenium.sub),
                          x = coords_sub$x, 
                          y = coords_sub$y)

cells_cluster3 <- colnames(xenium.sub)[xenium.sub$banksy_clusters == 3]

plot_df_sub$cluster3 <- plot_df_sub$cell %in% cells_cluster3

# Add cell type annotations
plot_df_sub$group <- xenium.sub$group[match(plot_df_sub$cell, colnames(xenium.sub))]

# Add Cluster 3 vs Other to object
xenium.sub$cluster3_status <- ifelse(plot_df_sub$cluster3[
    match(colnames(xenium.sub), plot_df_sub$cell)],
    "Cluster 3","Other")

# Figure 4A (left): Spatial distribution of Cluster 3 cells
ggplot(plot_df_sub, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey",
    size = 0.15) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_df_sub, cluster3),
    aes(colour = group),
    size = 0.4) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_void() +
  scale_color_manual(values = manual_col) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
```

## SEC enrichment
To determine whether Secretory Epithelial Cells (SECs) are enriched within Cluster 3, cell type composition is compared between Cluster 3 and all other cells in the normal fallopian tube region.
```{r SEC enrichment, fig.height = 4}
# Quantify enrichment of Secretory Epithelial Cells in cluster 3
# Fisher’s exact test 
ft_sec <- fisher.test(table(plot_df_sub$cluster3,
          xenium.sub$group == "Secretory Epithelial Cells"))
ft_sec

# Cell type composition
bar_data <- xenium.sub@meta.data %>%
  count(cluster3_status, group) %>%
  group_by(cluster3_status) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# Figure 4A (right): Cell type composition of Cluster 3 versus all other cells
ggplot(bar_data,
  aes(x = cluster3_status,
    y = prop,
    fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = .2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1))
          ,position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
          size = 3,
          check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = manual_col, breaks = legend_order) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cell type composition", fill = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(colour="black", size=8)) 
```

## TP53 high analyses
Here, TP53 expression is used to define TP53-high cells within the normal fallopian tube region.
```{r TP53 high, out.width="100%", fig.height = 2.5}
# Fetch TP53 expression
expr_sub <- FetchData(xenium.sub, vars = "TP53", layer = "data")

plot_df_sub$TP53 <- expr_sub$TP53

# Plot TP53 expression and distribution
TP53_spatial <- ggplot(plot_df_sub, aes(x = x, y = y, col = TP53)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    coord_equal() +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    theme_void() +
    scale_colour_gradient(low = "lightgrey", high = "blue") +
    ggtitle("TP53")
 
TP53_dist_incl_zeroes <- ggplot(plot_df_sub, aes(x = "", y = TP53)) +
                              geom_violin(fill = "lightblue", trim = FALSE) +
                              geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", fill = "white") +
                              theme_minimal() +
                              labs(title = "TP53 expression",
                                   x = "",
                                   y = "Log-normalised expression")

plot_df_nonzero <- subset(plot_df_sub, TP53 > 0)

TP53_dist_excl_zeroes <- ggplot(plot_df_nonzero, aes(x = "", y = TP53)) +
                    geom_violin(fill = "lightblue", trim = FALSE) +
                    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", fill = "white") +
                    theme_minimal() +
                    labs(title = "TP53 expression (non-zero only)",
                         x = "",
                         y = "Log-normalised expression")

# Define TP53-high cells
low_threshold <- quantile(plot_df_nonzero$TP53, 0.1)
low_threshold 

plot_df_sub$TP53_high <- plot_df_sub$TP53 > low_threshold

table(plot_df_sub$TP53_high)

# Spatial distribution of TP53-high cells
TP53_high <- ggplot(plot_df_sub, aes(x = x, y = y, col = TP53_high)) +
            geom_point(size = 0.3) +
            coord_equal() +
            scale_y_reverse() +
            theme_void() +
            scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
            ggtitle("High TP53 cells")
```

### TP53-high in Cluster 3
Here, we investigate whether TP53 high cells are enriched in cluster 3. Then we compare TP53 high cells vs TP53 low cells within cluster 3.
```{r TP53-high in Cluster 3, fig.height = 4}
# TP53-high enrichment Cluster 3
tbl <- table(Cluster_3 = plot_df_sub$cluster3,TP53_high = plot_df_sub$TP53_high)
ft_tp53_c3 <- fisher.test(tbl)
ft_tp53_c3

# Define TP53-high and TP53-low cells within Cluster 3
plot_df_sub$TP53_c3_status <- NA

plot_df_sub$TP53_c3_status[plot_df_sub$cluster3 
              & plot_df_sub$TP53_high] <- "TP53high_cluster3"

plot_df_sub$TP53_c3_status[plot_df_sub$cluster3 
              & !plot_df_sub$TP53_high] <- "TP53low_cluster3"

# Add classification to object
xenium.sub$TP53_c3_status <- plot_df_sub$TP53_c3_status[
  match(colnames(xenium.sub), plot_df_sub$cell)]

table(xenium.sub$TP53_c3_status)

# Restrict to Cluster 3 cells
xenium.c3 <- subset(xenium.sub, subset = !is.na(TP53_c3_status))

Idents(xenium.c3) <- "TP53_c3_status"

# Differential expression
markers_tp53_c3 <- FindMarkers(
  xenium.c3,
  ident.1 = "TP53high_cluster3",
  ident.2 = "TP53low_cluster3")

# Significant upregulated genes
markers_tp53_c3_sig <- subset(markers_tp53_c3,
  p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0)

head(markers_tp53_c3_sig, 10)

# Figure 4B: Spatial distribution of TP53-high cells Cluster 3
plot_df_sub$state <- "Neither"

plot_df_sub$state[
  plot_df_sub$cluster3 & !plot_df_sub$TP53_high
] <- "Cluster 3"

plot_df_sub$state[
  !plot_df_sub$cluster3 & plot_df_sub$TP53_high
] <- "TP53+"

plot_df_sub$state[
  plot_df_sub$cluster3 & plot_df_sub$TP53_high
] <- "Both"

ggplot(plot_df_sub,
       aes(x = x, y = y, colour = state)) +
  geom_point(size = .3) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_void() +
  scale_colour_manual(
  values = c(
    "Neither"   = "grey90",
    "Cluster 3" = "#4E79A7",
    "TP53+"     = "#59A14F",
    "Both"      = "orange"
  ),
  breaks = c("Cluster 3", "TP53+", "Both"),
  labels = c(
        expression("Cluster 3 / " * TP53^low),
    expression(TP53^high),
    expression("Cluster 3 / " * TP53^high)
  )
) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 7)
    )
  ) 

# Figure 4B: TP53-high enrichment Cluster 3
bar_df_enr <- as.data.frame(prop.table(tbl, margin = 1))
bar_df_enr$Cluster_3 <- factor(
  bar_df_enr$Cluster_3,
  levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  labels = c("Cluster 3", "Other"))

ggplot(bar_df_enr,
  aes(x = Cluster_3,
    y = Freq,
    fill = TP53_high)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Freq, accuracy = 0.1) ),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey80",
    "TRUE" = "#59A14F"),
  labels = c( expression(TP53^"low"), expression(TP53^"high"))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = NULL,  y = expression(TP53^"high" ~ "percentage"), fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
    theme(legend.text=element_text(colour="black", size=8))
```

### TP53 target gene activity by Cluster 3 status
```{r TP53 target activity, fig.height = 4}
# Top 10 p53 target genes from Fischer et al.
# https://www.nature.com/articles/onc2016502#Tab1
func_p53_genes <- c("CDKN1A", "RRM2B", "MDM2", "SUSD6", "GDF15",
                     "BTG2", "DDB2", "GADD45A", "PLK3", "TIGAR")

func_p53_genes_present <- intersect(func_p53_genes,
  rownames(xenium.sub))

func_p53_genes_present

# Calculate module score
xenium.sub <- AddModuleScore(xenium.sub,
  features = list(func_p53_genes_present),
  name = "targets_p53")

Module_TP53_C3 <- FetchData(
  xenium.sub,
  vars = c("targets_p531",
    "cluster3_status"))

# Summary statistics
aggregate(
  targets_p531 ~ cluster3_status,
  data = Module_TP53_C3,
  FUN = median
)

# Statistical test
wt_tp53_c3 <- wilcox.test(targets_p531 ~ cluster3_status,
  data = Module_TP53_C3)
wt_tp53_c3

# Figure 4C: TP53 target gene module score comparing Cluster 3 and other cells
ggplot(
  Module_TP53_C3,
  aes(
    x = cluster3_status,
    y = targets_p531,
    fill = cluster3_status
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "p53 target gene module score"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Other" = "#beaed4",
      "Cluster 3" = "#beaed4"
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(-1, 3)
  )
```

### TP53 target gene activity by TP53 status
Here, p53 target gene activity is compared across TP53-high and TP53-low cells within and outside Cluster 3.
```{r TP53 target activity by status, fig.height=4}
# Define groups
plot_df_sub$TP53_cluster_group <- NA

plot_df_sub$TP53_cluster_group[
  plot_df_sub$cluster3 & plot_df_sub$TP53_high
] <- "TP53high_C3"

plot_df_sub$TP53_cluster_group[
  plot_df_sub$cluster3 & !plot_df_sub$TP53_high
] <- "TP53low_C3"

plot_df_sub$TP53_cluster_group[
  !plot_df_sub$cluster3 & plot_df_sub$TP53_high
] <- "TP53high_nonC3"

plot_df_sub$TP53_cluster_group[
  !plot_df_sub$cluster3 & !plot_df_sub$TP53_high
] <- "TP53low_nonC3"

# Add to object
xenium.sub$TP53_cluster_group <- plot_df_sub$TP53_cluster_group[
  match(colnames(xenium.sub), plot_df_sub$cell)
]

table(xenium.sub$TP53_cluster_group)

Module_TP53 <- FetchData(
  xenium.sub,
  vars = c("targets_p531", "TP53_cluster_group")
)

Module_TP53$TP53_cluster_group <- factor(
  Module_TP53$TP53_cluster_group,
  levels = c("TP53high_C3", "TP53low_C3",
    "TP53high_nonC3", "TP53low_nonC3")
)

# Supplementary Figure 4: TP53 target gene activity by TP53 and Cluster 3 status
ggplot(
  Module_TP53,
  aes(
    x = TP53_cluster_group,
    y = targets_p531,
    fill = TP53_cluster_group
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.2,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "p53 target gene module score"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "TP53low_nonC3"  = "grey80",
      "TP53high_nonC3" = "#59A14F",
      "TP53low_C3"     = "grey80",
      "TP53high_C3"    = "#59A14F"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "TP53low_nonC3"  = expression(TP53^"low"),
      "TP53high_nonC3" = expression(TP53^"high"),
      "TP53low_C3"     = expression(TP53^"low"),
      "TP53high_C3"    = expression(TP53^"high")
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      size = 10
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      size = 10
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      size = 10
    )
  ) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1, 2))

# Summary statistics
aggregate(targets_p531 ~ TP53_cluster_group,
  data = Module_TP53,
  median)

kt_tp53 <- kruskal.test(targets_p531 ~ TP53_cluster_group,
  data = Module_TP53)
kt_tp53

pw_tp53 <- pairwise.wilcox.test(Module_TP53$targets_p531,
  Module_TP53$TP53_cluster_group,
  p.adjust.method = "BH")
pw_tp53
```

## Secretory epithelial cells Cluster 3
Secretory epithelial cells (SECs) within Cluster 3 are compared to all other SECs within the normal fallopian tube region.
```{r SEC c3 v non-c3, fig.height = 4}
# Identify Secretory Epithelial Cells
cells_secretory <- colnames(xenium.sub)[xenium.sub$group == "Secretory Epithelial Cells"]

plot_df_sub$Secretory <- plot_df_sub$cell %in% cells_secretory

# Define SECs inside and outside Cluster 3
plot_df_sub$classify_secretory_c3 <- NA

plot_df_sub$classify_secretory_c3[
  plot_df_sub$Secretory &
  plot_df_sub$cluster3
] <- "Secretory_cluster3"

plot_df_sub$classify_secretory_c3[
  plot_df_sub$Secretory &
  !plot_df_sub$cluster3
] <- "Secretory_not_cluster3"

table(plot_df_sub$classify_secretory_c3, useNA = "ifany")

# Add classification to Seurat object
xenium.sub$Secretory_cluster3_status <-
  plot_df_sub$classify_secretory_c3[
    match(colnames(xenium.sub), plot_df_sub$cell)
  ]

table(xenium.sub$Secretory_cluster3_status, useNA = "ifany")

# Restrict analysis to SECs
xenium.secretory <- subset(
  xenium.sub,
  subset = !is.na(Secretory_cluster3_status)
)

Idents(xenium.secretory) <- "Secretory_cluster3_status"

table(Idents(xenium.secretory))

# Differential expression
markers_secretory_c3 <- FindMarkers(
  xenium.secretory,
  ident.1 = "Secretory_cluster3",
  ident.2 = "Secretory_not_cluster3",
  min.pct = 0.05
)

# Significant upregulated genes
markers_secretory_c3_sig <- subset(
  markers_secretory_c3,
  p_val_adj < 0.05 &
  avg_log2FC > 0
)

head(markers_secretory_c3_sig, 10)
```

## SEC immune microenvironment
Here, neighbourhood analysis of the immune microenvironment of SECs within cluster 3 vs outside cluster 3 (Other) is investigated.
```{r Neighbourhood analysis, fig.height = 4}
# Restrict to SECs
secretory_cells <- plot_df_sub %>%
  filter(!is.na(classify_secretory_c3))

# Create neighbourhood graph
radius <- 50

coords_all <- as.matrix(
  plot_df_sub[, c("x", "y")]
)

nn_radius <- frNN(
  coords_all,
  eps = radius
)

# Identify immune cells
macrophage_ids <- which(plot_df_sub$group == "Macrophages")
tnk_ids <- which(plot_df_sub$group == "T & NK Cells")

# Count neighbouring immune cells
count_neighbours <- function(cell_id, target_ids){

  idx <- match(
    cell_id,
    plot_df_sub$cell
  )

  neigh_idx <- setdiff(
    nn_radius$id[[idx]],
    idx
  )

  sum(neigh_idx %in% target_ids)
}

secretory_cells$mac_count_50um <- sapply(
  secretory_cells$cell,
  count_neighbours,
  target_ids = macrophage_ids
)

secretory_cells$tnk_count_50um <- sapply(
  secretory_cells$cell,
  count_neighbours,
  target_ids = tnk_ids
)

# Total neighbours for density normalisation
secretory_cells$total_neighbours_50um <- sapply(
  secretory_cells$cell,
  function(cell_id){

    idx <- match(cell_id, plot_df_sub$cell)

    length(
      setdiff(
        nn_radius$id[[idx]],
        idx
      )
    )
  }
)

# Neighbourhood composition
secretory_cells$mac_pct_50um <-
  100 * secretory_cells$mac_count_50um /
  pmax(secretory_cells$total_neighbours_50um, 1)

secretory_cells$tnk_pct_50um <-
  100 * secretory_cells$tnk_count_50um /
  pmax(secretory_cells$total_neighbours_50um, 1)

# Plotting labels
secretory_cells$classify_secretory_c3 <- factor(
  secretory_cells$classify_secretory_c3,
  levels = c("Secretory_cluster3", "Secretory_not_cluster3"
  ),
  labels = c("Cluster 3", "Other")
)

# Figure 4E: SEC immune composition Macrophages
ggplot(
  secretory_cells,
  aes(
    classify_secretory_c3,
    mac_pct_50um,
    fill = classify_secretory_c3
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, fill = "#8CD17D") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Macrophages within 50 μm (%)"
  )+
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(legend.title=element_text(colour="black", size=9))

# Figure 4E: SEC immune composition T & NK killer cells
ggplot(
  secretory_cells,
  aes(
    classify_secretory_c3,
    tnk_pct_50um,
    fill = classify_secretory_c3
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, fill = "#79706E") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "T & NK cells within 50 μm (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(legend.title=element_text(colour="black", size=9))

# Spatial visualisation
macrophages <- plot_df_sub %>%
  filter(group == "Macrophages")

tnk_cells <- plot_df_sub %>%
  filter(group == "T & NK Cells")

plot_cells <- bind_rows(

  secretory_cells %>%
    mutate(cell_type = as.character(classify_secretory_c3)),

  macrophages %>%
    mutate(cell_type = "Macrophages"),

  tnk_cells %>%
    mutate(cell_type = "T & NK Cells")
)

x0 <- max(plot_df_sub$x) - 150
y0 <- max(plot_df_sub$y) + 100

# Figure 4E: Spatial distribution of immune microenvironment surrounding SECs
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_df_sub,
    aes(x, y),
    colour = "grey92",
    size = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_cells,
    aes(x, y, colour = cell_type),
    size = 0.4
  ) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
coord_equal() +
scale_colour_manual(
  breaks = c(
    "Cluster 3",
    "Other",
    "Macrophages",
    "T & NK Cells"
  ),
  values = c(
    "Macrophages" = "#59A14F",
    "T & NK Cells" = "#79706E",
    "Cluster 3" = "#4E79A7",
    "Other" = "#F28E2B"
  )
  ) +
    annotate(
    "segment",
    x = x0,
    xend = x0 + 50,
    y = y0-250,
    yend = y0-250,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x0 + 25,
    y = y0 -200,
    label = "50 μm",
    size =4.4
  ) +
    theme_void()  +  
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(size = 4))) 

# Distance metric
# Secretory cell coordinates
sec_coords <- as.matrix(
  secretory_cells[, c("x", "y")]
)

# Macrophages
mac_coords <- as.matrix(
  plot_df_sub %>%
    filter(group == "Macrophages") %>%
    select(x, y)
)

nn_mac5 <- get.knnx(
  data = mac_coords,
  query = sec_coords,
  k = 5
)

secretory_cells$mean_dist_mac5 <-
  rowMeans(nn_mac5$nn.dist)

# T & NK cells
tnk_coords <- as.matrix(
  plot_df_sub %>%
    filter(group == "T & NK Cells") %>%
    select(x, y)
)

nn_tnk5 <- get.knnx(
  data = tnk_coords,
  query = sec_coords,
  k = 5
)

secretory_cells$mean_dist_tnk5 <-
  rowMeans(nn_tnk5$nn.dist)

# Figure 4E: SEC immune proximity Macrophages
ggplot(
  secretory_cells,
  aes(
    classify_secretory_c3,
    mean_dist_mac5,
    fill = classify_secretory_c3
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, fill = "#8CD17D") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Mean distance to 5 nearest Macrophages (μm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=11)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=11)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=10)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(colour="black", size=11)) +
  theme(legend.title=element_text(colour="black", size=11))

# Figure 4E: SEC immune proximity T & NK killer cells
ggplot(
  secretory_cells,
  aes(
    classify_secretory_c3,
    mean_dist_tnk5,
    fill = classify_secretory_c3
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, fill = "#79706E") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Mean distance to 5 nearest T & NK cells (μm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=11)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=11)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=10)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(colour="black", size=11)) +
  theme(legend.title=element_text(colour="black", size=11))

# Statistical summary
p_mac_pct <- wilcox.test(
  mac_pct_50um ~ classify_secretory_c3,
  data = secretory_cells
)$p.value

p_tnk_pct <- wilcox.test(
  tnk_pct_50um ~ classify_secretory_c3,
  data = secretory_cells
)$p.value

p_mac_dist <- wilcox.test(
  mean_dist_mac5 ~ classify_secretory_c3,
  data = secretory_cells
)$p.value

p_tnk_dist <- wilcox.test(
  mean_dist_tnk5 ~ classify_secretory_c3,
  data = secretory_cells
)$p.value

results <- data.frame(
  test = c(
    "Macrophage % within 50 μm",
    "T & NK % within 50 μm",
    "Mean distance to 5 nearest macrophages",
    "Mean distance to 5 nearest T & NK cells"
  ),
  p_value = c(
    p_mac_pct,
    p_tnk_pct,
    p_mac_dist,
    p_tnk_dist
  )
) 

results$FDR <- p.adjust(
  results$p_value,
  method = "BH"
)

results
```

## Co-localisation SCNAs
Here, co-localisation of SCNAs are investigated within the normal fallopian tube region, with a particular focus on chromosome arms 3q and 8q.
```{r Co-localisation SCNAs, out.width="100%", fig.height = 4}
# Load chromosome arm log ratios from SpatialCopyInference workflow
arm_ratios <- readRDS("Data/arm_ratios_ovarian.rds")

# Convert chromosome arm matrix to dataframe
arm_means_df <- as.data.frame(t(arm_ratios))

# Restrict to cells present in the normal region subset
arm_means_df_sub <- arm_means_df[rownames(arm_means_df) %in% colnames(xenium.sub), ]

# Define chromosome arm gains
threshold <- 0.1  
chr3q_pos_sub <- arm_means_df_sub$chr3_q >= threshold
chr8q_pos_sub <- arm_means_df_sub$chr8_q >= threshold

# Create analysis dataframe
coords_sub <- GetTissueCoordinates(xenium.sub, image = "fov")

co_plot_sub <- data.frame(
  cell = colnames(xenium.sub),
  x = coords_sub$x,
  y = coords_sub$y,
  cluster3 = colnames(xenium.sub) %in% cells_cluster3,
  chr3 = chr3q_pos_sub,
  chr8 = chr8q_pos_sub
)

co_plot_sub <- co_plot_sub %>%
  mutate(
    region = ifelse(
      cluster3,
      "Cluster 3",
      "Other"
    ),
    status = case_when(
      chr3 & chr8  ~ "chr3q & chr8q gain",
      chr3 & !chr8 ~ "chr3q gain only",
      !chr3 & chr8 ~ "chr8q gain only",
      TRUE         ~ "Neither"
    ),
    both_gains = chr3 & chr8,
    neither = !(chr3 | chr8)
  )

co_plot_sub <- co_plot_sub %>%
  mutate(
    coloc_state = case_when(
      chr3 & chr8 & cluster3 ~ "Cluster 3: chr3q & chr8q gain",
      chr3 & chr8 ~ "chr3q & chr8q gain",
      cluster3 ~ "Cluster 3",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Enrichment tests: Cluster 3 versus Other
ft_chr3 <- fisher.test(
  table(
    Cluster3 = co_plot_sub$cluster3,
    Chr3gain = co_plot_sub$chr3
  )
)

ft_chr8 <- fisher.test(
  table(
    Cluster3 = co_plot_sub$cluster3,
    Chr8gain = co_plot_sub$chr8
  )
)

ft_both <- fisher.test(
  table(
    Cluster3 = co_plot_sub$cluster3,
    BothGains = co_plot_sub$both_gains
  )
)

ft_neither <- fisher.test(
  table(
    Cluster3 = co_plot_sub$cluster3,
    Neither = co_plot_sub$neither
  )
)

# Figure 4D: Spatial distribution of chr3q and chr8q gains
ggplot(
  co_plot_sub,
  aes(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    colour = coloc_state
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Other" = "grey90",
      "Cluster 3" = "#4E79A7",
      "chr3q & chr8q gain" = "#59A14F",
      "Cluster 3: chr3q & chr8q gain" = "orange"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Cluster 3",
      "chr3q & chr8q gain",
      "Cluster 3: chr3q & chr8q gain"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7)
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 4)
    )
  )

# Chr3q and chr8q co-localisation inside cluster 3
cluster3_df <- subset(co_plot_sub, cluster3)

tab_cluster3 <- table(chr3q = cluster3_df$chr3,
  chr8q = cluster3_df$chr8)

ft_cluster3 <- fisher.test(tab_cluster3)
ft_cluster3

# Bubble plot
bubble_df <- co_plot_sub %>%
  count(region, status) %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Figure 4D: Enrichments bubble plot
bubble_df$status <- factor(
  bubble_df$status,
  levels = c("chr3q & chr8q gain",
    "chr8q gain only",
    "chr3q gain only",
    "Neither"))

ggplot(bubble_df, aes(x = region, y = status, size = Percentage)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21,fill = "#fdc086", colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = subset(bubble_df, Percentage >= 20),
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage)),
    size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = subset(bubble_df, Percentage < 20),
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage)),
    size = 3,
    nudge_x = 0.42) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 24,name = "Percentage") +
  labs(x = "Region", y = "chr3q/chr8q gain status") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size=9)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(colour="black", size=10)) +
   theme(axis.title.x=element_text(colour="black", size=10))+
    theme(legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7)) 

# Figure 4D: Odds ratios forest plot
forest_df <- data.frame(
  Feature = c(
    "Neither",
    "chr3q gain only",
    "chr8q gain only",
    "chr3q & chr8q gain"
  ),
  OR = c(
    unname(ft_neither$estimate),
    unname(ft_chr3$estimate),
    unname(ft_chr8$estimate),
    unname(ft_both$estimate)
  ),
  Lower = c(
    ft_neither$conf.int[1],
    ft_chr3$conf.int[1],
    ft_chr8$conf.int[1],
    ft_both$conf.int[1]
  ),
  Upper = c(
    ft_neither$conf.int[2],
    ft_chr3$conf.int[2],
    ft_chr8$conf.int[2],
    ft_both$conf.int[2]
  ),
  P = c(
    ft_neither$p.value,
    ft_chr3$p.value,
    ft_chr8$p.value,
    ft_both$p.value
  )
)

forest_df

tabletext <- cbind(
  c( forest_df$Feature),
  c( rep("", nrow(forest_df))),
  c(paste0(sprintf("%.2f", forest_df$OR),
      " (", sprintf("%.2f", forest_df$Lower),
      "–",sprintf("%.2f", forest_df$Upper),")")),
  c(ifelse( forest_df$P < 2.2e-16, "<2.2 × 10⁻¹⁶",sprintf("%.2e", forest_df$P))))
```
